system.description:
After you damage a creature with your Primary or Secondary Weapon, or successfully damage a creature with a Tech Domain card, you may apply one Intrusion.

Each creature may only have one Intrusion from you at a time. Applying another replaces the previous one.

Intrusion

Effect

Expose

The next attack against the target has Advantage. Then the Intrusion fades.

Jam

The target has Disadvantage on its next attack. Then the Intrusion fades.

Interference

Reduce the damage die of the target's next attack by one step. Then the Intrusion fades.

Trace

You always know the target's location until the end of the scene.
